title: Remove ssh-import-id from server-minimal (LP: #1974483)
description:
Backport of fix for LP: #1974483 from Mantic to Jammy. Removes ssh-import-id from the server-minimal metapackage such that openssh-server is not always implicitly installed on server. See [1] for the respective change to the seeds.

[1] https://code.launchpad.net/~cpete/ubuntu-seeds/+git/ubuntu/+merge/468628
